content.text: I found additional control and lifecycle paths outside the receipt’s focused scenarios. I’m checking their triggers against the templates and transport so the findings identify observable failures and exact lines.

{
  "role": "code-review",
  "head": "8698a1e640ca70fcbeb43f1eddbd04ca2aa0718b",
  "base": "ad92a0864ac56987a4896fd5770abab0c0c9b271",
  "verdict": "request_changes",
  "signal": "fail",
  "summary": "The native monitor introduces unresolved control and lifecycle defects: a stale Goto confirmation can command a later selection, slow Booklet reads can be canceled indefinitely, and sorting a state column can terminate the monitor stream.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/group-monitor/group-monitor.component.ts",
      "line": 348,
      "title": "Bind Goto confirmation to the selection and access that opened it",
      "evidence": "The time-restriction dialog callback reads the current selection and checked sessions when it closes. It is not canceled on a route or access transition. If the operator opens it for group A, switches to group B, selects a block there, and then confirms the old dialog, testCommandGoto sends a command to B using the time confirmed for A. A selection change within the same group has the same problem.",
      "recommendation": "Capture the intended selection, target IDs, group and access scope when opening the dialog; cancel the confirmation and pending command on route, access or component teardown, and reject changes to the captured context."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/group-monitor/test-session-manager/test-session-manager.service.ts",
      "line": 152,
      "title": "Do not repeatedly cancel slow Booklet enrichment",
      "evidence": "Each five-second snapshot replaces the entire Booklet-enrichment observable with switchMap. Booklet requests use ref-counted sharing, so if a Booklet takes longer than the snapshot interval, each new snapshot unsubscribes and aborts the preceding read before it can populate the cache. A consistently six-second Booklet response can therefore prevent rows from ever rendering despite the 20-second HTTP deadline. The focused slow-snapshot test covers the snapshot request, not this subsequent enrichment.",
      "recommendation": "Keep in-flight Booklet reads alive across snapshot replacements or coordinate snapshot and enrichment work so it can finish within the existing deadline; retain cancellation on disconnect and access changes."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/group-monitor/test-session-manager/test-session-manager.service.ts",
      "line": 411,
      "title": "Handle absent Booklet states and options when sorting",
      "evidence": "The state-column list is the union of states from all displayed Booklets, but the comparator dereferences each row's state definition and selected option whenever that row has any bookletStates object. A row with a different Booklet, an unset state, or an outdated option makes this throw. The error propagates through the subscription into the sessions BehaviorSubject, terminating monitor updates instead of sorting the rows.",
      "recommendation": "Resolve each state and option defensively, including the defined default where appropriate, and use a stable fallback for missing or obsolete values. Add coverage for mixed Booklets and partially populated state objects."
    }
  ],
  "verified": [
    "Confirmed the pinned HEAD and tree, inspected the committed diff, current source, relevant tests, checked-in documentation, and the named Original source.",
    "Traced signed-int64 snapshot decoding and numeric selection serialization, profile loading and cancellation, access-scoped requests, polling, Booklet caching, finish-all handling, and monitor control rendering.",
    "The supplied receipt associates focused local tests, typecheck, a 468.75 kB production build, and 16 headed Chrome markers with HEAD 8698a1e and its matching tree. It records fresh CI as pending.",
    "The earlier five-finding review and its negative tests concern 60df907; the current source contains the described finish-all, profile, snapshot-polling, cache-retry and navigation fixes, so those historical findings were not repeated without current evidence.",
    "The cache-environment proof concerns the earlier 5d9ba6c-to-60df907 fix and does not establish current CI success."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "This was a read-only source review; no broad suite was rerun, and the three reported scenarios were established by source tracing rather than a new browser reproduction.",
    "The repository Brain brief failed because the read-only sandbox prevented creation of its lock directory; direct source inspection was used instead.",
    "The historical receipts do not establish whole-project or visual parity, and no current matching CI completion evidence was supplied."
  ]
}
